card.name: The word day after a or each
card.fires_on: The word "day" right after "a" or "each" in rates such as "mg a day" or "liters a day". Also fires on an opening quote mark after "a" or "new", and rarely on odd characters inside foreign names.

modes.label: Per-day rates
modes.description: "day" ends a rate phrase after a or each, following an amount.
modes.example: is already producing 130,000 liters of fresh water a<< day>>.

modes.label: Opening quote after a
modes.description: A quotation mark opens a coined term right after "a" or "new".

modes.label: Inside foreign names
